# Subject log API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Records followed over time for one subject, such as weight, food and water, or housing.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/subjectlog/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/subjectlog/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `subject_log` (detail, create, update), `subject_logs` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `subject` → `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Entry schemas:** `type` selects a [SubjectLog type](/api/schemas/subjectlog/); each log entry is validated against it.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `type` | one of the [SubjectLog types](/api/schemas/subjectlog/) **[required]** |
| `description` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `subject` | [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `protocol` | [`protocol`](/api/personal_attributes/protocol/) id; nullable; nestable |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |
| `entries` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/subjectlog/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('subjectlog', load_all=True)
records = resp['subject_logs']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('subjectlog', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.subject_logs;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "subject_logs": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "type": "FoodConsumption",
            "description": "",
            "subject": "<subject-id>",
            "protocol": "<protocol-id>",
            "user": "<user-id>",
            "entries": null
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/subjectlog/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('subjectlog', data={"type": "FoodConsumption", "subject": "<subject-id>"})
record = resp.json()['subject_log']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('type', 'FoodConsumption', 'subject', '<subject-id>'), 'subjectlog');
record = created.subject_log;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/subjectlog/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('subjectlog', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['subject_log']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab

record = out.subject_log;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "subject_log": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "type": "FoodConsumption",
        "description": "",
        "subject": "<subject-id>",
        "protocol": "<protocol-id>",
        "user": "<user-id>",
        "entries": null
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/subjectlog/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('subjectlog', id='<id>', data={"description": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'description', 'new value'), 'subjectlog', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/subjectlog/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('subjectlog', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'subjectlog');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `add_entry` | PATCH `/api/private/modules/subjectlog/<id>/add_entry/` |
| `change_entry` | PATCH `/api/private/modules/subjectlog/<id>/change_entry/` |
| `remove_entry` | PATCH `/api/private/modules/subjectlog/<id>/remove_entry/` |

Log entries are edited through the actions: `add_entry` appends an entry validated against the log type's schema, `change_entry` replaces one entry and `remove_entry` deletes it.

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Subject log data model page](/datamodel/modules/subjectlog/).
{% endraw %}

## Usage notes

- `entries` holds the log's entries, each an object such as `{"date_time": "2026-03-14T10:06:58Z", "details": {...}, "notes": null, "performedBy": <user id>}`. `details` follows the schema of the log's `type`. Duration-based logs (housing, deprivation, habituation, handling and training) record a start and an end time instead of a single time. Add, change and remove entries with the `add_entry`, `change_entry` and `remove_entry` [custom actions](#custom-actions).
